name: Business Card Template
author: Fahim Web Developer

sections.description:
The Business Card Template plugin is a powerful and flexible solution for WordPress users looking to create stylish, responsive digital portfolios or custom post types. Ideal for freelancers, creatives, and business professionals, it helps you present projects, services, case studies, or testimonials in a clean, professional layout.

With an intuitive interface and responsive design, the plugin offers seamless portfolio management with no coding required. Easily tailor your digital content to match your brand and captivate your audience.

Features included

  • Digital Business Card Builder

  • Easily create and customize digital business cards directly in your WordPress dashboard.

  • Multiple Layout Options

  • Choose from a variety of stylish business card templates designed for professionals.

  • Fully Customizable Fields

  • Add and edit fields like name, title, phone number, email, website, social links, and more.

  • Responsive Design

  • Your business card looks perfect on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.

  • Shortcode Integration

  • Display your business card anywhere on your site using a simple shortcode.

  • Social Media Links

  • Add and customize icons for popular platforms like LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram, and more.

  • vCard Download Option

  • Allow users to download your contact details as a .vcf file (virtual contact file).

  • Gutenberg Block Support

  • Insert business cards into posts or pages using a dedicated block.

  • Multilingual & Translation Ready

  • Ready for translation with included .pot file to localize your business card.

  • Lightweight & Fast

  • Optimized for speed and performance with clean, minimal code.

Development & Source

This plugin uses a modern JavaScript build process with webpack.

The full human-readable source code is included within this plugin in the /src directory.

To build from source:

  1. Run npm install
  2. Run npm run build
  3. The compiled output will be generated in the /build folder
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Upload or search for Business Card Template
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
